meaning: After browser local edits, mutate only the synthetic store authority/revision. Submit stale expected revision through the verified adapter and return actual conflict. No auto-overwrite/revision retry is permitted.
Test predeclared read-only refusal, then a separate allowed-initial save whose source becomes read-only before processing. Distinguish correct expected rejection from an actual bypass.
Hold response for submitted local snapshot A, allow browser editing to B, then acknowledge A. Stored A and dirty local B must remain correctly distinguished.
Reject a save with a verified retryable failure while preserving local edits. A later explicit user Save may succeed; never infer success from local optimistic UI.
Commit submitted snapshot but return save_failed. Re-read exposes confirmed current draft/revision; local newer edits remain dirty and no automatic write occurs.
